experiments.title: Require finite-input handling for numeric CLI operations
experiments.instruction_change: Numeric operations must define and test behavior for nan and infinity when the CLI accepts floats.
experiments.success_criteria: The follow-up arithmetic PR passes review without an edge-case-gap rejection.
experiments.result: PR 15 added finite-input validation and tests and was merged. Continue observing future arithmetic PRs.

experiments.title: Require README updates for workflow changes
experiments.instruction_change: Workflow and agent changes must update README usage documentation and link the relevant guide.
experiments.success_criteria: The next workflow or agent PR includes the required README usage update without a documentation-gap finding.
experiments.result: PR 19 was retrospectively tagged for a missing README update. The README correction and instruction change are now in place; observe the next workflow PR.

experiments.title: Validate and normalize workflow input fields at their boundary
experiments.instruction_change: Workflow and agent inputs must normalize documented equivalent forms, reject malformed values clearly, and test every accepted form.
experiments.success_criteria: The next three coordinator dispatches using numeric and hash-prefixed issue references complete issue selection without input-parsing failures.
experiments.result: PR 61 fixed the coordinator failure caused by issue input #58. Observe the next three dispatches before evaluating the guidance.

experiments.title: Keep shared agent guidance independent of the consumer application
experiments.instruction_change: Shared instructions and role agents read project identity and commands from agentic-project.json instead of hardcoding application-specific values.
experiments.success_criteria: The next two non-calculator consumer setups can use the shared guidance without editing calculator-specific instructions.
experiments.result: The adapter contract and generic agent guidance are now present; validate the next non-calculator consumer setup.
